The new retry cleanup broadens deleteMany in a way that can remove non-SMS reminders after two failures.
Adds a non-null retryCount column with a default value; no correctness issue is evident from the migration alone.

findings.claim: The new deleteMany condition changed from filtering only SMS reminders to an OR that includes any row with retryCount > 1. Because the second branch has no method constraint, once other reminder types start using or inheriting retryCount values, this cron will delete non-SMS WorkflowReminder records as well. Keep the retry-count purge scoped to method: SMS (or otherwise explicitly limit the affected reminder types) to avoid cross-method data loss.
findings.title: Retry cleanup deletes reminders from every workflow method
